newsitem.title: USA: Delaware Gov names Metts to fill education post.
newsitem.headline: Delaware Gov names Metts to fill education post.

text.p: Delaware Gov. Thomas Carper said Monday he would nominate Iris Metts to fill a newly created Secretary of Education post.
Metts was previously Superintendent of the Christina School District.
Carper said he would officially submit Metts's name to the state Senate when the legislature reconvenes Tuesday.
If confirmed, her annual salary would be $110,400.
